result.rationale: Verified in AddGuestsDialog.tsx: `setIsInvalidEmail(true)` is set on validation failure, but onSuccess only calls `setMultiEmailValue([""])` and `setIsOpenDialog(false)` — it never resets `isInvalidEmail`. The Dialog's `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` also bypasses any reset. Only the explicit cancel button resets it. So a stale red validation error can persist after a successful add or overlay-close reopen. Minor UI-state defect, but real and introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure (handleAdd) but is only reset in the Cancel button handler. It is NOT cleared on successful mutation (`onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue` and closes but doesn’t call `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), nor when the dialog is closed via overlay/Escape because `Dialog` uses `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` directly with no reset logic. Since the dialog component stays mounted under `BookingListItem`, reopening can show a stale validation error and preserve partially entered emails.
